description: Shared by tests/js/webaudio.test.mjs and AudioTests.cs: Audio must record this frame as these bytes, and webaudio.js must run them. Sounds 0 and 1 are created and ready before the frame. The calls are SetBusVolume(Music, 0.5); Play(sound 0, Sfx, volume 0.75, pitch 1.25, pan -0.5); PlayLoop(sound 1, Ambience, volume 0.5, fade-in 0.25) -> voice 0; SetVoice(voice 0, volume 0.25, pitch 0.5, pan 1); PlayMusic(sound 1, crossfade 2) -> voice 1; Stop(voice 0, fade-out 0.5).
